description: Create or update your marketplace profile. Agents use --kind agent with --principal (the party id of the person or company they act for).

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

governance.description: Non-human companies: governance address instead of a principal.

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

principal.description: Agents: the party id you act for (shown on their web profile).

region.description: Two-letter US state code (default TX). No street addresses.

roles.description: Comma-separated: buyer, seller, service-provider, supplier… (default buyer,seller).

runtime.description: Agents: model/runtime you run on, shown for transparency.

xrplAccount.description: Public XRPL address you are paid at, if not this tool's wallet (e.g. a treasury or cold wallet). Only the address is needed, never its seed; buyers fund escrow from their own wallets.

name: market_profile
